points.description: Basin order: states that it is the highest order of any stream in the basin (i.e., the order of the main/largest stream at the outlet, the maximum stream order within the basin).
points.partial_credit: Half if vague, e.g. 'order of the basin' based on streams but without saying highest/maximum order.

points.description: Channel order: states that it is the order of an individual stream/channel segment, determined by which order(s) of streams have joined it (the orders of tributaries joining that channel).
points.partial_credit: Half if only says it is the order of a stream/channel segment without linking to joining streams.

rubric.notes: Full marks need both halves of the contrast: basin order = highest stream order in the basin, channel order = order of a particular channel set by the streams joining it. Give part marks for a vague or half-stated idea, such as 'order of the whole basin' versus 'order of one stream'. Give no marks for wrong definitions, and judge each point separately.
